shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Soft gold prestige glow on interactive elements like buttons and cards on hover/focus

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and micro-interactions

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action button used throughout the site.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D4AF37; color: #F7F7F5; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem 2rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: user-select; transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #D4AF37cc; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D4AF3780; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { background: #111111; color: #F7F7F5; border: 1px solid #AEB7C140; border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { background: #111111; color: #F7F7F5; border-color: #D4AF37; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #D4AF3730; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #AEB7C110; color: #AEB7C160; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Containers for sections like founder bios, workshop previews, etc.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #111111; color: #F7F7F5; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; transition: background 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { background: #111111cc; }

narrative.overview: Elegant, secure, refined, and welcoming. Whispers rather than shouts — no exaggeration, no loud marketing. Inspired, human, sophisticated without being cold. Refined & tonal elevation philosophy (consistent with "marcas premium sussurram, não gritam" — sombras pesadas/táteis tendem a contradizer essa filosofia de discrição).
keyCharacteristics: Primary colors: Gold Prestige and Midnight Premium
Neutral palette: Cloud White, Silver Mist, Executive Black
Typography: Cinzel for headlines, Montserrat for body, Inter for UI labels
Refined, tonal elevation without heavy shadows
Component restraint: subtle interactions, refined proportions

rules.name: The Refined Tonal Rule
rules.body: Elevation is conveyed through tonal layering and subtle transparency rather than heavy shadows; shadows appear only as ambient glows on interactive states.

rules.name: The Hierarchy Clarity Rule
rules.body: Display sizes scale fluidly with viewport width to ensure impact across devices while maintaining editorial proportion; body text maintains comfortable line length (65–75ch) for readability.

dos: Do use Gold Prestige (≥30% opacity) for accent elements and calls-to-action; its rarity conveys exclusivity.
Do pair Cinzel headlines with Montserrat body at a minimum 1.25x scale step for hierarchical clarity.
Do keep corner radius consistent at 8px (lg) for cards and buttons to maintain visual rhythm.
Do apply ambient low hover glow only on interactive elements; never use heavy drop shadows.
Do maintain body line length between 65–75ch for optimal readability.
donts: Don't use neon gradients, badges, or aggressive SaaS startup patterns (anti-reference from PRODUCT.md).
Don't pair two similar sans-serifs or two geometric fonts without contrast axis.
Don't animate width, height, or layout properties; limit motion to transform and opacity.
Don't use drop shadows heavier than 4px blur; prefer tonal layering and transparency for elevation.
Don't set body text lighter than 4.5:1 contrast against its background; always verify accessibility.
